follow-up time: Daily until PUUS grade declined to 1 or 0
outcome: Effectiveness of the Postpartum Uterine Ultrasonographic Scale (PUUS)
finding: The study introduces the PUUS, a novel and simple method for evaluating postpartum uterine involution, which can be used routinely to standardize uterine cavity involution assessment.
mod_finding: The study found that PUUS grade of uterine involution varied with the day of examination and mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean).
